hooks.command: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $root='C:\Phoenix Projects\CompuTech'; $d=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd()|ConvertFrom-Json; $f=$d.tool_input.file_path; if($f -match 'CompuTech\.(Domain|Application|Infrastructure|API)'){$date=Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'; Add-Content "$root\docs\BITACORA.md" "`n- [$date] Modificado: $f" -Encoding utf8}

$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $root='C:\Phoenix Projects\CompuTech'; $d=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd()|ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd=$d.tool_input.command; if($cmd -match 'dotnet ef'){$date=Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'; $p="$root\docs\04-migraciones\ef-log.txt"; if(-not(Test-Path $p)){New-Item -Force -ItemType File $p|Out-Null}; Add-Content $p "[$date] $cmd" -Encoding utf8}

$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $root='C:\Phoenix Projects\CompuTech'; $date=Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'; $cut=(Get-Date).AddHours(-8); $ff=Get-ChildItem $root -Recurse -File|Where-Object{$_.LastWriteTime -gt $cut -and $_.Extension -match '\.(cs|json|md)$' -and $_.FullName -notmatch 'obj|bin|\.claude'}; if($ff){$count=$ff.Count; Add-Content "$root\docs\BITACORA.md" "`n## Fin de sesión — $date ($count archivos modificados)" -Encoding utf8; $ff|ForEach-Object{Add-Content "$root\docs\BITACORA.md" "- $($_.FullName)" -Encoding utf8}}
